title: Understanding Mini-batch Gradient Descent
text: Mini-batch gradient descent is a compromise between stochastic gradient descent and batch gradient descent. It uses a subset of the data to compute the gradient at each step.

title: Gradient Approximation
text: In mini-batch gradient descent, the gradient is calculated using a small random subset of the data, which may not represent the entire dataset accurately.

title: Evaluating the Description
text: Does the description 'the gradient is approximated and may not descend towards the true minimum' apply to mini-batch gradient descent?
